integrity: All central conclusions proved algebraically; finite checks and self-review are not independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Coordinate-marked coefficient counts, not geometric isomorphism classes; geometric isogeny for supersingular locus; no complete extension-field zeta function, endomorphism classification or Ekedahl–Oort type. Broad genus-three Newton polygon results and unindexed work are residual originality risks.
title: Cartier rigidity and the supersingular hyperplane of characteristic-two Picard quartics
